ContentBuilder.GET_STARTED_TEXT: To get started, you'll need to create some content. You can create:
ContentBuilder.AVATARS_DESCRIPTION: • Avatars - Wearable characters players can puppeteer or embody
ContentBuilder.PROPS_DESCRIPTION: • Props - Additive objects that can be spawned in any world
ContentBuilder.WORLDS_DESCRIPTION: • Worlds - Custom environments & games to explore
ContentBuilder.NAME: Name
ContentBuilder.SCREEN_EFFECTS-TOOLTIP: Includes visual effects that alter or overlay on the user's screen, such as shaders or animations.
ContentBuilder.FLASHING_EFFECTS-TOOLTIP: Contains rapidly flashing or changing lights, colors, materials, or textures, which may cause discomfort or photosensitivity.
ContentBuilder.JUMPSCARE-TOOLTIP: Sudden visual or audio event designed to startle the user.
ContentBuilder.SUGGESTIVE-TOOLTIP: Displays sexual innuendo, poses, or outfits that expose a lot of skin.
ContentBuilder.VIOLENCE-TOOLTIP: Features depictions of harm, injury, or destruction including weapons or damage.
ContentBuilder.HORROR-TOOLTIP: Designed to scare using spooky visuals, sounds, or horror tropes.
ContentBuilder.GORE-TOOLTIP: Includes graphic content such as blood, wounds, or detailed injury visuals.
ContentBuilder.EXPLICIT-TOOLTIP: Includes adult-only content such as nudity or sexual objects.
ContentBuilder.VALIDATION_ERROR_TEXT: If you are seeing this text that means something is wrong.
ContentBuilder.UPLOAD_DESCRIPTION: Builds and uploads your content to ChilloutVR.
ContentBuilder.LOCALTEST_DESCRIPTION: Builds your content and launches ChilloutVR to test locally.

Validations.ALL_GOOD_MESSAGE: All good! No issues found. Your content is ready to be built & uploaded.
Validations.AVATAR_ZERO_VIEWPOINT: The view position of this avatar defaults to X=0,Y=0,Z=0. This means your view position is on the ground. This is probably not what you want.
Validations.AVATAR_CONSIDERED_SHORT: The view position of this avatar is under 0.5m in height. This avatar is considered excessively small.
Validations.AVATAR_CONSIDERED_HUGE: The view position of this avatar is over 3m in height. This avatar is considered excessively huge.
Validations.PROP_ANIMATOR_MISSING: No Animator found on spawnable root. Make sure, that an Animator is present on the same GameObject as the CVRSpawnable Component.
Validations.AVATAR_ANIMATOR_MISSING: No Animator found on avatar root. Make sure, that an Animator is present on the same GameObject as the CVRAvatar Component.
Validations.AVATAR_ANIMATOR_GENERIC: The Avatar field in your Animator is not filled. Your Avatar will be considered as generic Avatar.
Validations.AVATAR_ANIMATOR_NOT_HUMANOID: Your Avatar is not setup as Humanoid.
Validations.WORLD_NULL_SPAWNPOINT: The world contains a spawnpoint that is null or missing. You didn't intend to do this, right?
Validations.WORLD_SPAWNPOINT_OUTSIDE_MAX_BOUNDS: One or more spawnpoints are located outside the maximum playable bounds ({MAX_PLAYABLE_BOUNDS}). Please reposition them closer to origin.
Validations.WORLD_SPAWNPOINT_BELOW_RESPAWN: One or more spawnpoints are below the respawn height ({RESPAWN_HEIGHT}). Please raise their position above the respawn plane.
Validations.CAMERA_NO_TARGET_TEXTURE: Camera(s) found with no target texture. This camera will be destroyed by the client on load unless it has a target texture.
Validations.POTENTIAL_DEPTH_LIGHT: Potential prefab depth light(s) detected. These are likely part of visual effects from assets like Mochie, Poiyomi, etc. and are not needed in ChilloutVR.
Validations.POTENTIAL_MISCONFIGURED_PLAYER_LIGHT: Potentially misconfigured light(s) affecting Avatars detected. These lights affect either the Player Local or Player Network layers without affecting the other. Different lighting between Local and Remote Avatars is usually unwanted behaviour. You should review any Lights, Cameras, and GameObjects for misconfigured layer usage if this happens to be a port from another platform.
Validations.NONE_LEGACY_BLENDSHAPES: Model(s) found with blendshape normals set to calculate. This will lead to an increased filesize and lighting errors.
Validations.LONG_RANGE_AUDIO: Found AudioSource(s) set to 2D or with maxDistance > {MAX_ALLOWED_DISTANCE}. This is considered Long Range Audio.
Validations.LOUD_AUDIO: Found AudioClip(s) exceeding {MAX_DECIBEL_THRESHOLD} dB. This is considered Loud Audio.
Validations.AUDIO_LOAD_IN_BACKGROUND: Found AudioClip(s) not set to load in background. It is recommended to have `Load In Background` enabled to prevent locking up the main thread during initial audio load.
Validations.AUDIO_DECOMPRESS_ON_LOAD_TOO_LONG: Found AudioClip(s) using 'Decompress on Load' with a length greater than 1 second. This can cause stuttering during load as decompression occurs on the main thread. Consider using 'Compressed in Memory' instead.
Validations.AUDIO_STREAMING_MODE: Found AudioClip(s) using 'Streaming' load type. Streaming audio increases CPU overhead during playback. Consider using 'Compressed in Memory' instead.
Validations.AUDIO_CLIP_LENGTH_WARNING: Found AudioClip(s) longer than {0} seconds. Long audio clips consume significant memory. Consider splitting them into shorter segments or reducing quality settings.
Validations.MISSING_SCRIPTS: Found GameObject(s) with missing script references. Attempting to build will result in an error.
Validations.BROKEN_SCRIPTS: Found MonoBehaviour(s) with broken Mono Script references. This can sometimes happen when renaming scripts which are already being used in scene.
Validations.PARTICLE_PREWARM_LONG_LIFETIME: Found ParticleSystem(s) with Prewarm enabled and a Start Lifetime greater than {0} seconds. Prewarming simulates the entire lifetime on activation, which can cause significant hitches with long lifetimes or complex particle systems.
Validations.TOTAL_TRIANGLES_WARNING: Total triangle count is {TRIANGLE_COUNT}, which may impact performance.
Validations.TOTAL_TRIANGLES_INFO: Total triangle count is {TRIANGLE_COUNT}, consider optimizing.
Validations.TOTAL_MATERIALS_WARNING: Total material slot count is {MATERIAL_COUNT}, which may impact performance.
Validations.TOTAL_MATERIALS_INFO: Total material slot count is {MATERIAL_COUNT}, consider reducing.
Validations.TOTAL_RENDERERS_WARNING: Total renderer count is {RENDERER_COUNT}, which may impact performance.
Validations.TOTAL_RENDERERS_INFO: Total renderer count is {RENDERER_COUNT}, consider optimizing.
Validations.MISSING_OR_BROKEN_SHADERS: Found Material(s) with missing shaders or Shader(s) with compilation errors. These must be fixed to ensure they render properly in VR.
Validations.POTENTIALLY_NONSPI_SHADERS: Found Shader(s) that may potentially lack stereo rendering (SPI) support. This could affect how they appear in VR. It's recommended to review them for compatibility.
Validations.REQUIRES_STREAMING_MIPMAPS: Found problematic Texture(s) used on Mesh Renderers without streaming mipmaps enabled.
Validations.UNNECESSARY_STREAMING_MIPMAPS: Found Texture(s) with Streaming Mip Maps enabled in unsupported contexts. Texture Streaming in Unity requires a MeshRenderer or SkinnedMeshRenderer for proper usage. In contexts like Particle Systems, Streaming is unsupported and can result in incorrect LOD behavior.
Validations.REQUIRES_ZERO_PRIORITY_STREAMING_MIPMAPS: Found Texture(s) with Streaming Mip Maps enabled but not set to zero priority. This is required for Avatars and Props to be at 0.
Validations.REQUIRES_NON_READABLE: Found Texture(s) that are set to Read/Write enabled. This must be disabled for Avatars and Props.
Validations.TEXTURE_TOO_LARGE: Found Texture(s) exceeding the maximum allowed dimensions of 8192x8192. These need to be resized or clamped via the Texture Import Settings.
Validations.EDITOR_SERIALIZATION_MODE_ERROR: Asset Serialization Mode is not set to 'Force Text' in Editor Settings. You must change this setting to build content using the CCK.
Validations.EDITOR_SERIALIZATION_MODE_CHANGE_MESSAGE:
Changing the serialization method for assets may force a reimport of some or all assets immediately in the project.

Are you sure you wish to change the asset serialization mode?
Validations.UNSUPPORTED_UNITY_VERSION_ERROR: Unity version '{0}' is not supported. The CCK requires a Unity version between '{1}' and '{2}'.
Validations.UNSUPPORTED_BUILD_TARGET_ERROR: The active build target '{0}' is not supported. Supported build targets are: {1}.
Validations.UNSUPPORTED_BUILD_TARGET_CHANGE_MESSAGE:
Switching the active build target will trigger a reimport of assets, which may take a significant amount of time.

Which platform would you like to switch to?
